agents.name: Weekly threat brief
agents.does: Researches the last 30 days of exploited vulnerabilities, breaches, supply chain attacks, outages and law enforcement actions, checks primary sources such as DOJ, CISA and the CERTs, rebuilds the rolling brief on this site and publishes it, with a New this week section showing what changed.

agents.name: Monthly archive
agents.does: Once a month closes, researches that month alone and writes it into the archive, which feeds the month by month timeline.

agents.name: Morning brief
agents.does: A daily personal summary to start the day. Switched off for now.

agents.name: Heartbeat
agents.does: Periodic check-ins through the day. Switched off for now.

agents.name: Session tracker
agents.does: Works through the Security Congress session list: plays each session video, completes the session evaluation, and keeps a spreadsheet of sessions, credits and what is left against the 31 Jan 2027 reporting deadline.

agents.name: Job watch
agents.does: Watches job postings. Its numbers will appear here once it reports.

agents.name: Game server
agents.does: The Minecraft server. Players, uptime and activity will appear here once it reports.
